incident_kind.name: incident_kind
incident_kind.value: ("incident"."kind" = 'student' and "incident"."student_id" is not null) or ("incident"."kind" = 'teacher' and "incident"."teacher_id" is not null) or ("incident"."kind" = 'staff' and "incident"."staff_id" is not null)

invoice_period.name: invoice_period
invoice_period.value: "invoice"."period_to" is null or "invoice"."period_from" is null or "invoice"."period_to" >= "invoice"."period_from"

login_identity_admin_link.name: login_identity_admin_link
login_identity_admin_link.value:
("login_identity"."portal" = 'admin') = ("login_identity"."admin_staff_id" is not null)
    and ("login_identity"."portal" = 'teacher') = ("login_identity"."teacher_id" is not null)
    and ("login_identity"."portal" = 'parent') = ("login_identity"."contact_id" is not null)
    and ("login_identity"."portal" = 'student') = ("login_identity"."student_id" is not null)

product_prices.name: product_prices
product_prices.value: "product"."price_pence" >= 0 and ("product"."merit_price" is null or "product"."merit_price" > 0) and ("product"."stock" is null or "product"."stock" >= 0)

sibling_rule_values.name: sibling_rule_values
sibling_rule_values.value: "sibling_discount_rule"."position" between 2 and 20 and "sibling_discount_rule"."kind" in ('deduct', 'add') and "sibling_discount_rule"."unit" in ('pence', 'percent') and "sibling_discount_rule"."amount" >= 0 and ("sibling_discount_rule"."unit" <> 'percent' or "sibling_discount_rule"."amount" <= 10000)

teacher_log_times.name: teacher_log_times
teacher_log_times.value: "teacher_log"."time_out" is null or "teacher_log"."time_in" is null or "teacher_log"."time_out" >= "teacher_log"."time_in"
